concerns.text: T090 (Weighting scheme definition) is marked [P] (parallel-safe) but T090b (Synthetic datasets) explicitly depends on T090. T091 (Power analysis) depends on T090b. T091-Check depends on T091. These tasks form a strict serial chain (T090 -> T090b -> T091 -> T091-Check) and cannot be parallelized. Marking them all as [P] is a semantic violation of the parallel-safe tag.

T004 (Define data model) and T006 (Define schemas) are marked [P] and appear in Phase 0, but T006 explicitly depends on T004. T007 depends on T006. T008 depends on T007. This is a serial dependency chain (T004 -> T006 -> T007 -> T008). Marking them all as [P] violates the producer-before-consumer ordering for parallel execution.

T037a (CLI entry point) is placed in Phase 3 (US1) but is a foundational infrastructure task required to orchestrate the entire pipeline (including Phase 0 tasks like power analysis and Phase 2 data collection). It should precede Phase 0 or be in a dedicated 'Setup' phase before any data generation or analysis tasks to ensure the pipeline can be executed in the correct order.

T020 (Data preprocessing) depends on T051 (Anonymise) and T101 (Pre-analysis guard). T051 depends on T015b-Real (Real data ingestion). However, T015b-Real is listed in Phase 3 (US1) while T020 is in Phase 4 (US2). This is correct, BUT T015b-Real is marked [P] and placed alongside T013 (Stimulus generation). T015b-Real depends on T014 (Counterbalancing) which depends on T013. The [P] tag on T015b-Real is incorrect as it cannot run until T014 completes.

T027 (Sensitivity analysis) depends on T090 (Weighting scheme) and T021 (LMM fit). T090 is in Phase 0. T021 is in Phase 4. T027 is in Phase 5. This ordering is correct. However, T027 is marked [P]. It cannot run in parallel with T021 (its dependency) or T090 (its dependency). The [P] tag is invalid here.

T090 is marked [X] (completed) but T090b depends on it. If T090 is truly completed, the dependency chain is valid, but the [P] tag on T090b, T091, and T091-Check remains incorrect as they are serially dependent on T090 and each other.
